newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola to upgrade global computer system.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola to upgrade global computer system.

text.p: The Coca-Cola Co said Thursday it is launching a multi-million dollar expansion and upgrade of its management information system over the next five to seven years.
The change will integrate Coca-Cola's systems worldwide to provide immediate market information to Coca-Cola management, associates, bottlers and customers, the company said.

"The goal is to give us a tool to help us understand what is happening in the marketplace in real time," said company spokeswoman Kerry Traubert. "It's one of the top strategic intiatives for the company."
The company declined to say how much the project cost.

As part of the program, the company has signed an agreement with Ernst & Young for consulting services and picked SAP AG, a software solutions company based in Germany, to provide technology infrastructure.
